verdict.rationale: Docs show a 5-minute GitHub/GitLab app setup that automatically reviews every PR with in-line review comments (Fix-with-Agent buttons attached to comments), and independent community use confirms real-world deployment where Greptile posts PR comments that let authors reply/fix before human review (greptile-docs-1, greptile-docs-5, greptile-comm-8). Missing for 10: explicit first-party wording confirming comments render as native GitHub/GitLab inline review comments (vs. summary-only), and more recent independent corroboration of the 'minutes to first review' claim (older HN threads report reliability issues, though those concern codebase Q&A rather than PR review itself).
